event.description: Share symmetric query-key geometry while retaining head-specific skew components
event.proposal: Family: attention organization. Current retained frontier is 1,672 parameters at 99.010000%, a +0.010000 percentage-point margin over 99%. There have been 5 prior attempts in this family. The most recent accepted result is attempt-0020, which removed attention output projections and qualified at 3,168 parameters and 99.94%; the most recent failed result is attempt-0098, whose fully head-shared asymmetric bilinear form scored 0.03% at 1,465 parameters. Together with attempt-0097's 0.00% symmetric per-head result, the evidence indicates both directionality and head identity matter. Hypothesis: head identity is carried primarily by the directed antisymmetric component, while undirected similarity geometry can be shared. This major representational change stores one shared 136-scalar symmetric form, two head-specific 120-scalar skew forms, and the 256-scalar value map, yielding 1,585 parameters by checkpoint decomposition. It is more informative than an arbitrary low-rank factorization because it preserves the two exact structural components separately falsified by attempts 0097 and 0098, changing only whether the symmetric component is head-specific. Generic causal softmax self-attention and autoregressive decoding remain intact.
